cards.claim: GDT684 proposes a common preparation-head interpretation for the complete CH/SH/T+OL family: chol → Trockenansatz; shol → Feuchtansatz; tol → Kaltansatz. In its V57 reader these appear at six chol positions, one shol and one tol. The proposal is conditional on inspecting all already admitted exact occurrences and local material/action heads, and on the same composition explaining those contexts better and more compactly than trocken/feucht/kalt plus Gut/Material. A local head may specify the carrier, but a carrier must not be invented globally.

evidence.quote:
## Nächster Zug

Der kleinste produktive Bedeutungsversuch ist die vollständige
`CH/SH/T + OL`-Familie. In V57 stehen sechs `chol`, ein `shol` und ein `tol`.
Die Arbeitsvorhersagen lauten:

```text
chol -> Trockenansatz
shol -> Feuchtansatz
tol  -> Kaltansatz
```

Der nächste Versuch soll alle bereits zugelassenen exakten Vorkommen dieser drei Oberflächen
und ihre lokalen Stoff-/Aktionsköpfe durchgehen. Die Karte darf übernommen
werden, wenn dieselbe Komposition die Kontexte besser und kürzer erklärt als
„trocken/feucht/kalt; Gut/Material“. Ein lokaler Kopf darf den Träger
konkretisieren; er darf nicht global erfunden werden.

scope.registered_question: Inspect the complete admitted exact-form circuit before adopting the common preparation head.
scope.limit: Historical proposal only; GDT685 successor judgement belongs in a separate source-revision dossier, not an inherited empirical semantic rejection.

comparison.reason: The surviving tol=kalt and separate naked ol=Grundansatz claims are not the proposed universal three-form preparation-head family. No exact active historical family card was located in the bounded check.

source_reassessments.reason: Known GDT684 attempt ID is retained as provenance, not relabelled an independent idea. Its primary next-step section explicitly proposes the three named mappings and condition; no extracted component ID for this exact span was located.
